verdict.rationale: Figma Make is a hosted SaaS app builder, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no versioned API or deprecation policy. A community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files and the file format is undocumented, and probes for OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
